name: shadcn
label: shadcn/ui
description: Aesthetic layer from shadcn/ui: neutral palette, semantic colour roles (light and dark), radius scale, type scale, shadows and component recipes. shadcn-vue uses the same CSS variables, so one profile serves both.

companion.note: Port of shadcn/ui for Vue; same CSS variable names.

values.source: Default Theme CSS (neutral base colour) in apps/v4/content/docs/(root)/theming.mdx, branch main, as published on https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/theming
values.verify: Neutral steps 300, 600 and 700 are not in the theming page; they are the matching Tailwind CSS v4 neutral steps (MIT). Shadow values are the Tailwind CSS v4 defaults that shadcn/ui components use.

taken: Neutral palette (OKLCH, achromatic) and the way semantic roles map onto it in light and dark
Destructive hue and chroma, chart colours
Radius scale derived from one base value (sm 0.6, md 0.8, lg 1, xl 1.4, 2xl 1.8)
Type scale and weights used by the components (text-xs to text-4xl)
Component recipes: heights, paddings, borders, focus treatment, states (see components.json)
CSS variable names of the alias layer (--background, --primary, --sidebar-*, ...)
not_taken: No source code, no React or Vue components (the stack templates install them from the upstream registry)
No logos, no brand names in the generated profile
No web font files; the profile names a font family only

structure.source: Material Design 3 guidelines (published layout and component guidance; no assets, icons or fonts)
taken: Window size classes: compact < 600, medium 600-839, expanded >= 840
Bottom sheet, navigation bar (bottom tab bar), navigation rail, FAB, top app bar, segmented button, chips, snackbar placement, list row heights
